answer.location_description: Top-right corner of the image, roughly the top 3–4 rows across the right half (columns ~14–22). This is far from the centred nodule.
answer.shortcut_type: bright corner patch/marker (artifact at image border)
answer.mechanism: Brightness in the top-right corner switches off the malignancy pathway. The hidden units that otherwise act as large-nodule/ring detectors (10, 16, 19, 23) carry strong negative weights there, so a bright corner suppresses them. Units 16 and 10 drive the malignant layer-2 units: u8 (+39/+61) and u15 (+68), which have positive output weights, and they inhibit u0, u9 and u12, which have negative output weights. Unit 19's net path to the output is also positive. Some benign-type units (0, 8, 25, 5) have mildly positive weights near the top-right (rows 0–7, cols 18–21). These feed u0, u9 and u12, which have negative output weights. Net effect: a bright top-right region pushes the logit toward benign.
answer.evidence: Unit 19, row 0, cols 12–23: -35 -30 -49 -58 -72 -49 -69 -59 -51 -52 -36 -45. Rows 1–2 there are similar, -30 to -70. Unit 23, rows 0–2, cols 15–23: about -21 to -60 (e.g. r0: -31 -41 -45 -38 -60 -53 -49). Unit 10, rows 0–2, cols 14–21: about -30 to -52. Unit 16, rows 0–2, cols 15–21: about -37 to -56. These are among the largest-magnitude weights in those units outside the nodule region. The left side of the same rows has small or positive weights, so the pattern is sharply asymmetric. It cannot be explained by lung or chest-wall anatomy in a nodule-centred crop. Benign-type units have positive weights in the same corner area, for example unit 8 r0 col 21 = 45 and r2–r4 cols 19–20 = 40–49, and unit 0 r2–r3 cols 20–21 = 41–44. Tracing unit 16 through the layer-2 and output weights gives a strongly malignant-promoting contribution. Suppressing it, together with unit 10, therefore lowers the logit.
answer.main_feature: Nodule size and extent. Centre-surround units with a small positive core at rows 11–12, cols 11–12 and a negative ring respond to small, compact nodules in dark lung and push toward benign. Units with a negative centre and a positive ring at rows 7–9 and 14–16 respond to large or extended bright nodules and push toward malignant.
